strategy_roster.name: ADX Slope Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Twenty-bar ROC of ADX(14) is a slope proxy, and a two-standard-deviation breakout retains the documented multiplier. Reverting to nonpositive slope exits; the explicit 2% stop is retained.

strategy_roster.name: Vlt Trader
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar minimum-range lookback is an explicit fallback; a break of the prior candle's extremes represents the armed stop orders. Tick offsets and protection distances have no supplied values and are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Tick Delta Volume
strategy_roster.notes: Bar-level volume_ratio(10) is used as the closest OHLCV proxy for per-tick volume delta. The mean-plus/minus-one-standard-deviation signal and Length=10 are retained; the opposite signal exits.

strategy_roster.name: ADX MA Crossover
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(15) on median price approximates the source SMMA, and ADX must exceed the documented 16 threshold. The opposite crossover is a long exit proxy; pip stop, target, and trailing settings have no numeric values.

strategy_roster.name: PZ Parabolic SAR EA
strategy_roster.notes: The two SARs are approximated by aligned EMA(10) and EMA(20) trend lines, with the documented step settings mapped to those periods. ATR stop/trailing, partial closing, and break-even state cannot be expressed in the roster DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Wss Trader
strategy_roster.notes: A rolling 20-bar Camarilla pivot is a daily-data fallback, with the long side selected when price trades above it. London hours, metric-point offsets, targets, and trailing stops are unavailable or have no percentage values.

strategy_roster.name: Stochastic Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) substitutes for stochastic %K, while a 20-bar mean plus two standard deviations retains the documented lookback and multiplier. Falling back below its average exits; the source names a percent stop but supplies no value.

strategy_roster.name: Easy Robot
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish and bearish completed candles are the documented long-side and reversal proxies because explicit historical-bar access is unavailable. ATR factors, pip-based protection, trailing, and the holding timer are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: C Factor HLH4 Buy Only
strategy_roster.notes: The entry is exactly a close above the previous candle high; the two target branches become previous-low and prior-high exits after dropping unnormalizable 100/20-tick offsets. Configurable pip protection and risk sizing are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Pairs Trading Country ETFs
strategy_roster.notes: A 60-day z-score of one price is an explicit single-security proxy for the unsupported second ETF and price ratio. EntryZ=-1 and ExitZ=0 are fallbacks because the docs provide neither numeric level; the minimum-dollar filter is unsupported.
